work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CCLII (protocol LF43418–43421) condones past absence and grants perpetual exemption from residence and choir to beneficed clergy serving the royal chapel of Spain while they serve, and ends with its own 6 August 1833 closing at LF43593–43596, before numeral CCLIII at LF43599. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF43418–43418; the source closing at LF43593–43596 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die sexta augusti millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo tertio, pon- tificatus Nostri anno tertio. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
